leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply different cursor values to HTML elements to visually indicate interactive states
Configure pointer-events to control whether an element can be the target of mouse interactions
Construct interactive UI components by combining cursor and pointer-events properties
Manipulate element interactivity by toggling pointer-events between 'auto' and 'none' states
Implement custom cursor feedback for buttons, links, and form elements
Control layered element interactions by adjusting pointer-events on overlapping components
Update existing CSS rules to include cursor and pointer-events declarations
